The app creates the game folder on its first launch.

Folder:
%1$s
(This folder is at the root of shared storage, alongside folders such as Download and DCIM.)

%2$s

Copy the original PC release assets into this folder, preserving their directory structure. Then close and reopen the app.

To read and write files in a non-private folder (outside Android/data), you need to grant this app storage access.\nThe first launch takes 2-3 seconds longer because the touch control icons need to be extracted and copied.
The game folder could not be created or is not writable. Check storage access and available space.
Storage settings could not be opened. Enable storage access in Android Settings, then close and reopen the app.
